none: PAS NLM-5858BA: Roman Coin: Nummus of Valentinian I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), Victory left issue, Reece period 19. Chipped. Obverse description: Bust diademed draped and cuirassed left. Obverse inscription: [--]VS PF AVG. Reverse description: probably Victory advancing left. Reverse inscription: probably [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 14.6mm, Weight: 1.18gms, die axis: 6
